The Suites

Four suites, one address.

Úna, Duáo, Tréi, Pátru, named for the Vlach numerals of Metsovo. Each with its own character, sharing one private courtyard at the very center of the village.

The Courtyard

A quiet stone courtyard at the center of it all, where mornings begin slowly, framed by potted roses and the sound of the village waking up. Shared by all four suites, it is a small retreat of its own, natural stone paving, an old stone wall, and pots of roses and cypress trees.

Private, stone-paved courtyard
Outdoor seating area
Shared by all four suites
